title: SkyShift: zoom through time in NASA SPHEREx sky images
description: SkyShift is an open-source web tool and analysis toolkit for exploring how the sky changes in NASA SPHEREx near-infrared survey images. It selects wavelength-matched SPHEREx exposures of any sky position at four time scales (hours, days, months and a year), reads only the needed pixels from the public archive, and presents them as blink, slider and difference views with known Solar System objects labelled. A citizen-science mode trains users on planted synthetic movers calibrated by injection-recovery tests before they flag candidates in untouched data.
notes: Online showcase: https://mahadi5577.github.io/skyshift/. Includes the experiment scripts and findings behind the design (experiments/). Developed with generative-AI assistance; see AI_USE.md.
